title: pi-context-refs library
description: A Ref library file: ~/.pi/agent/pi-context-refs.json (the Global library) or <project>/.pi/pi-context-refs.json (the Project library). See DESIGN.md section 5. A schema cannot compare Refs with each other, so one rule is enforced only when the file is loaded: two Refs whose names differ only by case are a config error, and the later one is skipped. The loader also skips a single invalid Ref and keeps the rest, where a schema check fails the whole file.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so an editor can validate the file.

refs.description: The Refs. When two have the same name, the first one wins.

name.description: Letters, digits, ".", "-" and "_", never ending in ".". Names are case-insensitive.

path.description: A directory (its whole subtree) or a glob. ~ expands to the home directory.

remote.description: A git remote of the session's repository, written host/path, matched case-insensitively.

scope.description: Global library only. The Ref is visible only where the scope matches; when both are given, both must match.

kind.description: What the Ref stands for, fixed when it is saved.

path.description: Path and File: the target. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory; ~ expands.

command.description: Dynamic: the argument vector of a command, run with no shell. Use ["sh", "-c", "..."] when a shell is wanted.

url.description: Dynamic: an http or https URL, fetched with a plain GET.

cwd.description: Dynamic command only: the directory to run in, resolved like Ref paths.

max_bytes.description: File: raises the default cut of 50 KB or 2000 lines, up to 1 MB.

timeout.description: Dynamic: seconds before the run is stopped. Default 10, at most 120.

max_output.description: Dynamic: bytes of output kept. Default 50 KB, at most 1 MB.

tags.description: Labels that group Refs. #tag:<tag> stands for every Visible Ref with the tag.
